summary: CONTRACT_M6 2.1 (options: sensitivity, volume, cone display, saved in SaveData.options, applied at once, Par defaut), 2.2 (gamepad menus and controls line) and 2.3 (accessibility: eye shapes, edge pattern, dashed cone outline) are implemented. New Core/SaveOptions (SaveData.cs) with defaults/clamping/defensive parse; SaveStore.Options/SetOptions/ResetOptions apply AudioListener.volume at once. Menu.cs gained an Options page reachable from the title and the pause menu (new buttons, Chain-based navigation), driven either by a real device (existing InputSystemUIInputModule) or by new InputReader menu-navigation injection hooks (for headless PlayMode tests). OrbitCamera reads SaveStore.Options.Sensitivity to scale mouse/stick orbit rates. VisionConeView hides its floor cone (and a new dashed alert outline) under Cone="never", and shows the dashed outline whenever a watcher sees the furniture (the same flag that already tints the cone red). ProceduralArt's calm/suspicious eye is now half open with a "?" badge and the alarm eye wide open with a "!" badge (distinct shapes, not only colour); Hud got a striped pulse-pattern overlay shown only while seen moving, and the controls line swaps to gamepad names when InputReader reports the last input came from a gamepad.
tests: EditMode OptionsM6Tests (8 tests): Default_IsSensitivity1Volume80ConeAlways, Clamped_RoundsToTheNearestStep, Clamped_ClampsOutOfRangeToTheBounds, Clamped_InvalidConeFallsBackToAlways, Parse_MissingOptionsIsDefault, Parse_MalformedOptionsFallsBackFieldByField, Parse_ValidOptionsRoundTripThroughJson, SaveStore_SetOptions_RoundTripsThroughLoad. PlayMode ProbeTestsM6Options (4 tests): Step51a_OptionsAppliedAtOnce, Step51b_OptionsSurviveRestartAndReload, Step52a_MenusNavigableWithInjectedGamepadAlone, Step52b_EyeShapesEdgePatternAndConeOutline. All 12 pass; ran the full compile check 3 times (clean), plus targeted regression runs of ProbeTestsM3Look (10/10), ProbeTestsM5Ui (10/10) and ProbeTestsM5Game.Step38f_DogEyeShowsWithItsOwnShape (1/1), all green.

markers.marked: float steps = Mathf.Round((clamped - min) / step); // MUTATION:OPTIONS_STEP_ROUND
markers.replacement: float steps = Mathf.Floor((clamped - min) / step); // MUTATION:OPTIONS_STEP_ROUND

markers.marked: Cone = Cone == ConeNever ? ConeNever : ConeAlways, // MUTATION:OPTIONS_CONE_FALLBACK

removed_markers: LAST_DEVICE_KEYBOARD_WINS (InputReader.PollLastDevice's keyboard/mouse branch): added then removed, no real keyboard/mouse/gamepad device is active in a headless PlayMode test so the branch body never executes under test; the gamepad-swap behaviour itself is still covered end to end by CONTROLS_GAMEPAD_TEXT via InjectLastDevice.
probe_steps: Step51a_OptionsAppliedAtOnce: sensitivity scales the right stick orbit rate (InputReader.InjectLookStick), volume sets AudioListener.volume at once, "Jamais" hides the cone renderer and its alert outline while the eye indicator (Game.Seen / Hud.Eye) keeps working.
Step51b_OptionsSurviveRestartAndReload: SetOptions survives Game.Restart() and a fresh SaveStore.Load() from the same save file.

Step52a_MenusNavigableWithInjectedGamepadAlone: opens the pause menu (Start), D-pad down three times to the new Options button, A opens it, A on Sensibilite changes a value, B returns to the pause menu, Start resumes - all via InputReader injection, no real gamepad device.

Step52b_EyeShapesEdgePatternAndConeOutline: ProceduralArt.EyeCoverage confirms Closed/Calm/Alarm differ by shape; the pulse pattern shows only while seen moving (Game.SeenMoving > 0); the cone's dashed outline follows VisionConeView's own existing "alarm" flag (watcher sees the furniture at all, the same flag that already tints the cone red); the controls line swaps between Strings.HudControls and Strings.HudControlsGamepad with InputReader.InjectLastDevice.
